scripts.check: concurrently --success all --names packages,workspace "npm run check:packages" "npm run check:workspace"
scripts.check:workspace: concurrently --success all --names dependencies,experiments,suppressions "npm run check:dependencies" "npm run check:experiments" "npm run check:suppressions"
scripts.test: npm run test:tooling && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:tooling: npm run build --workspace microdelta && node --test tooling/*.test.mjs
